decision: Replace the PeeringDB facility point with the RUIAN address point for Mahlerovy sady 2699/1, Zizkov, Praha 3, the only address of the Zizkov television transmitter compound in which CRA operates DC TOWER.

identity_bridge: CRA's article 'Jak se staví datová centra' (dated 5. 12. 2017 on the page) says DC TOWER is hidden in the compound of the Zizkov television transmitter, in spaces that once held analogue transmission equipment, and that the transmitter site at Mahlerovy sady was chosen in 1984. CRA's 16 October 2025 release on the DC Tower expansion places the data centre in Prague-Zizkov. Mahlerovy sady 2699/1 is the only RUIAN address on that street.
